versions.content: Support of IEEE1722 Stream ACF Message handling Status: DRAFT Description: ACF messages of an IEEE1722 stream with subtype set to NTSCF or TSCF shall be available via signal / service translation for an application. Rationale: ACF Encapsulated bus frames (e.g. CAN, LIN) need to be processed by signal / service translation to provide data as event to the application. AP ECUs need to be able to monitor bus frames. Dependencies: RS_CM_00004 ▽ 12 of 36 Document ID 716: AUTOSAR_AP_RS_CommunicationManagement Requirements on Communication Management AUTOSAR AP R25-11 △ Use Case: An AP application of a high performance ECU receive events via S2S which are transported as ACF encapsulated bus frames (e.g. CAN, LIN) within an zonal automotive network Supporting Material: [4, IEEE1722]
